method: Actual PNG pixels opened with view_image, independently of numeric PASS. No OS controls were used in this fixture.

Grounded stance and raised swing foot visible; torso/head anchor stays level. One image alone does not establish movement comfort; actual physical stance samples are in motion report.
Opposed arms/legs, bent running elbow and swing knee visible; stable torso, no added camera bob. Procedural game gait, not mocap.

limits: Only these five final PNGs were actually opened by this agent. Jump/turbo images exist but are not asserted independently reviewed here.
GTA-level assets, a realistic face or a scanned/mocap human are not delivered by this procedural model.
Metre fixture review does not establish all-world geometry accuracy, 28-actor native appearance, OS keyboard acceptance, sustained frame rate or subjective comfort.
